errors.evidence: The description claims both lines fluctuate in the same range after 20,000 steps. However, the plot clearly shows the magenta line ("SimSMoE Validating") is consistently below the black line ("SMoE Validating") in this part of the graph, indicating better performance (lower BPC). This generalization is misleading.

The magenta line for "SimSMoE Validating" ends at a BPC of approximately 1.12, not 1.24. This error is significant as it incorrectly suggests that SimSMoE performs worse than SMoE at the end of the training, when the opposite is true.
